title: Instacart Considers a Potential Sale, Sparking Share Rally
description: Instacart has explored a potential sale of the grocery-delivery company, a process that has included discussions with Uber Technologies Inc., a person familiar with the matter said.

title: Apple’s iPhone Duo Hits Stores in Face of Short Supply and High Demand
description: Apple Inc. quickly sold out of its limited in-store inventory for the new iPhone Duo, underscoring the strong demand for a foldable device that starts at nearly $2,000.

title: $1,999 New iPhone 'Unfolds' During Affordability Crisis
description: Bloomberg's Lisa Mateo, Scarlet Fu, and Tom Keene discuss the release of the new Apple iPhone on this weeks edition of "Bloomberg Money." (Source: Bloomberg)
